text:
maria: Quick heads-up — changelog cutoff for v2.3.0 in ~20m. Can folks do a fast format pass on their entries? We're enforcing the small template today so the release notes stay compact. Please also call out any backports or version bumps that need manual handling. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

release-bot: Automated reminder: changelog cutoff scheduled at 1868001254 UTC. Please confirm when done.

kevin: on it. I have one tiny docs-only PR (props to ops-docs). Is the component tag `docs` fine or do you want `developer-experience`?

maria: `docs` is fine for that one — we group doc fixes under docs unless it touches runtime behavior.

jasper: quick build question — for the semver bump, do I apply it on `release/v2.3` or `main` and backport? I can script it either way but want to follow the flow you prefer.

olivia: bump on `release/v2.3` and we merge the bump into `main` after release. That avoids noise on main during the freeze.

kevin: added my entry: `- docs: tidy CLI help text (low impact) (PR #2942)` — pinging @maria for format check.

maria: looks good, just change parentheses spacing to match template, e.g. `- docs: tidy CLI help text (low impact) (PR #2942)` -> keep as-is, this one matches. :white_check_mark:

jasper: I scanned changelog folder for badly formatted bullets and found a couple. Command I ran: ```bash
rg "^[-+]" changelog/ || true
```
Found two entries missing component prefix. I'll fix and push.

sarah: I can do a light sweep for component tags and impact levels — will run a script against open PRs and ping any odd ones.

maria: super helpful, thanks. Quick reminder of the tiny template we're using if anyone needs it:
```
- <component>: short, imperative description (impact) (PR #)
  components: runtime | infra | docs | api | platform
  impact: none | low | medium | high
```
Keep entries to one line if possible.

kevin: done — PR updated and message posted.

release-bot: Noted: changelog entries updated by kevin at 1868001322.

olivia: FYI if you have backports, tag the PR title with `[backport v2.3]` so the release tooling picks it up automatically.

jasper: fixing the two malformed lines now, pushing in ~5m.

sarah: sweep finished — left comments on 3 PRs asking for component tagging.

maria: OK we should be in good shape. If anyone has a late critical item DM me — otherwise I'll cut the freeze at cutoff. Huge thanks to everyone for quick turnarounds. :tada:

release-bot: Change cutoff reached at 1868001410 UTC. Freezing changelog for v2.3.0 and tagging release artifacts.

maria: rolling forward with changelog compile + bump. If anything blocks, mention me now and I'll gate.
